sections.Profile:
"Victory" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1987, featuring a racing theme. The game includes four flippers, two ramps, and a single multiball mode. Designed by John Trudeau and John Borg, it is part of the Gottlieb System 80B series with a production run of 3,315 units.
